gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Simultaneous cost and schedule impact on this project routes first to the Owner's Representative per the delegation-of-authority letter, with the Electrical Engineer looped in as technical reviewer.
gold_routing_table.divergence_reason: Default discipline routing would keep this with the Electrical Engineer; this project's delegation letter pulls the owner's rep in whenever both cost and schedule are affected, regardless of discipline.

gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Urgent document discrepancies escalate directly to the Electrical Engineer for a fast resolution.
